decisionsTitle: The members' zone in three tabs: codes, shop, runs (amending §524, §683)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11:** «zona de membri are nevoie de tab-uri: coduri de reducere, magazin, alergări». The zone (§524) drew everything on one long page, and a member looking for the shop scrolled past the codes and the runs.

**Decision.** Three tabs, in the owner's order, each an address of its own: «Coduri de reducere» is the zone's own address `/members-area` (`/zona-membri`), drawn directly with no redirect; «Magazin» is `/members-area/shop` (`/zona-membri/magazin`); «Alergări» is `/members-area/runs` (`/zona-membri/alergari`) and holds the members' events and the next runs. Links, not a tab widget: the house's secondary-tab row (`SubNav`, §360), real navigation, the panel rendered on the server, no client island, the entries 44 px tall and a row that scrolls rather than wraps on a phone (§79's reason against MUI's scroll arrows). The sign-in's landing (`landingFor`), the members' page button and the backoffice layout's redirect keep pointing at `/members-area`, which now arrives at the first tab.

**The frame and the door.** The frame (title, greeting, the club's words for members, tabs, sign-out) is `members-area/zone.tsx`. The club's words (`readMembersZone`, §524, and the sentence the catalogue gives when none is written in both languages) stand above the tabs, so every tab shows them. The door is not the frame's: `openZone` is called by each page, because a layout is not re-run when a member moves between tabs, so the sign-in redirect, the 404 for an account that may not open the zone and the database-away page are asserted on every tab (BR-REQ-060-01). The frame is drawn synchronously; a page reads what it needs (`frameParts`: the words and whether the shop is one of the tabs) and hands it in. All the paths sit under the private segment already (`private-paths.ts`: `no-store`, `noindex`, `robots.txt`). The sign-out is a `SubmitButton` with its glyph, as the club's rule asks of a public button (§498), which retires the allowlist's bare-Button row for the members' page.

**The shop stays hidden until its notice.** «Magazin» is among the tabs only while the privacy notice in force names `{{membersShop}}` in every language, or the member has orders of their own to see (§683, BR-REQ-053-01 criterion 62: until that notice is in force the zone draws no shop). Otherwise there is no tab and `/members-area/shop` answers 404. Every tab pays one cheap read for it (the notice, then the member's orders). The shop's two verbs answer back to `/members-area/shop` with `?shop=` and `?shopAt=` (§683), and the order emails' button opens the same tab (`#members-shop`).

**While the database is away** (§447) a tab says so (`zoneAway`) rather than its empty-state sentence: «Coduri de reducere» and «Magazin» each tell «nothing yet» only when the database answered.

**Refused.** One long page again. Tabs as client state, with no address, no Back button and nothing with scripts off, or MUI `Tabs` (scroll arrows on a phone, a panel the server cannot render per address). Hiding an empty tab «Coduri de reducere» or «Alergări» (the tabs would change under a member from one visit to the next; the owner asked for the three); only the shop is conditional, because the notice decides it. Drawing «Magazin» for every member before the notice names the shop. Putting the runs at the zone's own address (the first tab, as the owner listed them, is the zone's door).
changelogLine: - **The members' zone in three tabs** — «Coduri de reducere» (the zone's own address), «Magazin» (once the privacy notice names the shop) and «Alergări», each its own address under the zone, the club's words above them, the shop's answers and order emails landing on «Magazin». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The members' zone shows its tabs in this order, «Coduri de reducere», «Magazin», «Alergări», as links 44 px tall, each part at its own address (`/zona-membri`, `/zona-membri/magazin`, `/zona-membri/alergari`), the current one marked `aria-current`, and only the current part drawn; the club's words for members stand above the tabs on every one (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Each of the members' zone's tab pages asserts the door itself: signed out it redirects to the sign-in in the members' words, an account that may not open the zone gets a 404 and no tab shows a way into the backoffice (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The members' zone draws the «Magazin» tab, and answers at its address, only while the privacy notice in force names `{{membersShop}}` in every language or the member has orders of their own; otherwise there is no tab and the address is a 404 (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
